_comment: Example character for the D&D 2024 Character JSON spec — a High Elf Wizard (full caster). Copy this as a starting point for your own PCs.
name: Lia Brightwood

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: Advantage on saves to avoid or end the Charmed condition; magic can't put you to sleep.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: Proficiency in Insight, Perception, or Survival (chose Perception).

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours of trancelike meditation.

traits.name: Elven Lineage — High Elf
traits.description: You know the Prestidigitation cantrip (Intelligence) and can swap it on a Long Rest; higher levels add Detect Magic and Misty Step.

weapons.name: Dagger
weapons.notes: Simple, Finesse, Light, Thrown, Nick, Range (20/60)

feats.name: Magic Initiate (Wizard)
feats.description: From the Sage background: two extra wizard cantrips and one level-1 wizard spell (cast 1/Long Rest without a slot).

class_features.name: Spellcasting
class_features.description: Intelligence is your spellcasting ability. Prepare wizard spells from your spellbook each day.

class_features.name: Ritual Adept
class_features.description: You can cast any spell with the Ritual tag from your spellbook as a ritual.

class_features.name: Arcane Recovery (1/day)
class_features.description: On a Short Rest, recover spell slots totaling up to half your wizard level (rounded up).

class_features.name: Scholar — Expertise
class_features.description: Expertise in Arcana (chosen from your wizard knowledge skills).

class_features.name: Evoker — Evocation Savant
class_features.description: Copying an Evocation spell into your spellbook costs half the time and gold.

class_features.name: Evoker — Sculpt Spells
class_features.description: When you cast an Evocation spell, you can shield a number of creatures = 1 + the spell's level; they auto-succeed saves and take no damage.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.notes: Spectral hand carries up to 10 lb. 1 min.

spells.name: Light
spells.notes: Object sheds bright light 20 ft. 1 hr.

spells.name: Shield
spells.notes: Reaction: +5 AC until your next turn; blocks Magic Missile.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.notes: Base AC becomes 13 + DEX while unarmored. 8 hr.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.notes: Ritual. Sense magic within 30 ft. Conc 10 min.

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.notes: Three rays, spell atk +5, 2d6 fire each.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.notes: Bonus Action: teleport up to 30 ft to a space you can see.

personality: Curious to a fault — will pause mid-battle to identify an unfamiliar magic effect.
